implementation.evidence_contract: Every stamped gate report retains its detailed evidence_state and adds release_evidence=passed|known_failure|unresolved. Only confirmed failed/known_failure states use upstream_failed markers and the PM replan path. Missing, stale, unreadable, pending, skipped, blind, and infrastructure_unavailable stay nonpassing and use upstream_unresolved plus 5_release_wait.
implementation.unresolved_route: release gate -> 5_release_wait; checkpoint approval starts a fresh 5_test evidence cycle; explicit rejection alone routes to 3
implementation.canonical: 5_test retains direct ownership handoff to 5_compile; 5_compile owns the only Godot compile/playtest gate; 5_vision owns readability; 5_final_test runs after 5_design; both run_tests nodes have repo_gate=false.
implementation.migration: The persisted generated-game migration accepts only the complete original, prior-r2, or target topology with exact ordered branches, post-design path, human-vision path, and unique tool ownership. It mutates a deep copy, validates the complete target graph, and commits to the caller only after success. Each saved file is independently contained; malformed YAML, tool_params:null, wrong routes, reordered branches, missing paths, duplicate ids, and duplicate gate owners remain byte-exact and cannot abort later files.
